basic.name: Shadowflame
basic.description: Deal 135~~0.05~~ damage to enemies in the area.

basic.name: Dread Orb
basic.description: Throw a bomb that will bounce three times, dealing 126~~0.05~~ damage to enemies.

basic.name: Runic Blast
basic.description: Detonate Cho's Rune Bomb, dealing 210~~0.04~~ damage around it.

basic.name: Double Back
basic.description: Activate to reverse the third bounce's direction.

heroic.name: Twisting Nether
heroic.description: After 1 second, nearby enemies are Slowed by 50% while Gall channels, up to 5 seconds. Activate to deal 353~~0.05~~ damage.

heroic.name: Shadow Bolt Volley
heroic.description: After 1 second, unleash 20 Shadow Bolts over 4 seconds, each dealing 87~~0.04~~ damage to the first target hit. The bolts fire towards your mouse.

heroic.name: Detonate Twisting Nether
heroic.description: Detonate the Twisting Nether, dealing 353~~0.05~~ damage.

trait.name: Ogre Rage
trait.description:
Activate to increase Gall's damage by 25%, but reduce Cho's Armor by 25.

Passive: Gall is permanently immune to Stun and Silence effects.

trait.name: Ogre Rage
trait.description:
Gall's damage is increased by 25%, but Cho's Armor is reduced by 25.

Cho can activate Ogre Hide to grant himself 25 Armor, but remove this damage bonus.

Passive: Gall is permanently immune to Stun and Silence effects.

mount.name: Shove
mount.description: Nudge Cho a small distance and grant him 25% Movement Speed for 2 seconds.

activable.name: Eye of Kilrogg
activable.description: Place an eye, granting vision of a large area around it for 45 seconds. The eye can be killed by enemies with 2 Basic Attacks. Stores up to 2 charges.

activable.name: Twilight Frenzy
activable.description: Activate to reduce the cooldowns of Shadowflame and Dread Orb to 2 seconds for the next 6 seconds.

level1.name: Keep Moving!
level1.description: Increases the Movement Speed bonus of Shove by 10% and its duration by 2 seconds.

level1.name: Taskmaster
level1.description: Every time Cho is hit by a Hero Basic Attack, reduce the cooldown of Shove by 1 second.

level1.name: We See You!
level1.description: Eye of Kilrogg's cooldown is decreased by 25 seconds, its range is increased by 33%, and the number of Basic Attacks required to kill it is increased by 1.

level4.name: Rising Dread
level4.description: Each bounce of Dread Orb increases its radius by 20% and damage by 15%. Activate Dread Orb before the second bounce ends to reverse the direction of the third bounce.

level4.name: Runic Persistence
level4.description: Runic Blast deals an additional 180~~0.04~~ damage over 3 seconds in an area around the detonation point.

level4.name: Bomb's Away
level4.description:
Quest: Damaging a Hero with Runic Blast increases its damage by 4.

Reward: After damaging 20 Heroes, the range and speed of Cho's Rune Bomb is increased by 20%.

level7.name: Edge of Madness
level7.description: Every subsequent hit of Shadowflame against the same enemy Hero deals an additional 12% damage, to a maximum of 60%. These bonuses are lost if the Hero has not been hit for 7 seconds.

level7.name: Double Trouble
level7.description:
Quest: If Shadowflame hits an enemy Hero that is afflicted by Cho's Consuming Blaze, its cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds.

Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, Shadowflame's cooldown is instead permanently reduced by 1 second.

level7.name: Ogre Rampage
level7.description: Increase the damage bonus of Ogre Rage by 5%. Each time Gall damages an enemy Hero while Ogre Rage is active, this bonus increases by 1% for 4 seconds, up to an additional 10% bonus damage.

level10.name: Shadow Bolt Volley
level10.description: After 1 second, unleash 20 Shadow Bolts over 4 seconds, each dealing 87~~0.04~~ damage to the first target hit. The bolts fire towards your mouse.

level10.name: Twisting Nether
level10.description: After 1 second, nearby enemies are Slowed by 50% while Gall channels, up to 5 seconds. Activate to deal 353~~0.05~~ damage.

level13.name: Searing Shadows
level13.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Shadowflame take an additional 2% of their maximum Health as damage.

level13.name: Psychotic Break
level13.description: Increase Gall's damage to enemy Heroes by 10%. Upon dying, Gall gains Ogre Rage and can use Abilities for 10 seconds.

level13.name: Twilight Nova
level13.description: After the first bounce of Dread Orb, 2 extra bombs bounce to the sides once.

level16.name: Leaden Orb
level16.description: Dread Orb Stuns enemy Heroes for 0.6 seconds.

level16.name: Deafening Blast
level16.description: Runic Blast Silences enemy Heroes for 1.25 seconds.

level16.name: Shadowsnare
level16.description: Enemy Heroes hit by your Basic Abilities are Slowed by 15% for 4 seconds. This effect can stack up to 2 times.

level20.name: Shadowfury
level20.description: Shadow Bolt Volley hits all enemies in its path.

level20.name: Shifting Nether
level20.description: Twisting Nether now teleports Cho to a targeted location before it begins Channeling.

level20.name: The Will of Gall
level20.description: Takedowns permanently increase the bonus of Ogre Rage by 2%.

level20.name: Twilight Frenzy
level20.description: Activate to reduce the cooldowns of Shadowflame and Dread Orb to 2 seconds for the next 6 seconds.
